source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 301 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 301 was established by Ordinance No. 20099, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 12, 1988. Ordinance No. 20099 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 301 is established on property generally located at the southeast corner of Audelia Road and Shadow Way. The size of PD 301 is approximately 1.3085 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 301A). (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A development plan must be approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of a building permit for work on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.106. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

(a) A landscape plan that conforms with the requirements of Article X must be approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of a building permit for any work on the Property.

(b) The existing trees indicated on the conceptual plan must be maintained on the Property and must also be indicated on the landscape plan required in Subsection (a) above. The landscape plan must show the specific types and calipers of the trees retained.

(c) A 25-foot landscape buffer strip must be maintained adjacent to Audelia Road and Shadow Way. The landscape buffer strip must contain one of the groups of plant materials described in Section 51A-10.107(a)(4).

(d) Landscaping must be installed within the time frame required in Section 51A-10.108.

(e) Landscaping must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.107. USES.

(a) Use of the Property is limited to a fire station and single family residential uses.

(b) Any single family use constructed on the Property must meet the yard, lot, space, and height restrictions applicable to the R-7.5(A) district as provided in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Masonry Wall
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.108. MASONRY WALL.

A six-foot-high solid masonry wall must be provided along the boundaries of the Property as indicated on the conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.109. ACCESS.

Access between the Property and Audelia Road is prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.110. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

The fire station must not exceed 10,000 square feet of floor area. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.111. SETBACKS.

The parking lot area shown on the conceptual plan must be set back a minimum of 25 feet from the west property line. The fire station shown on the conceptual plan must be set back a minimum of 70 feet from the north property line, a minimum of 65 feet from the east property line, and a minimum of 15 feet from the south property line. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.112. MAXIMUM STORIES.

The fire station is limited to one story. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.113. MAXIMUM HEIGHT.

The fire station must not exceed 30 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.114. MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum permitted lot coverage for the fire station is 18 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.115. OFF-STREET PARKING.

A minimum of 23 parking spaces must be provided for the fire station. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.116. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Division 51A-7.400. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.117. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-301.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 301 is located on Zoning Map No. D-9. (Ord. Nos. 20099; 25850)
